input_schema.directory_path: string | The full path of the directory to delete.
input_schema.recursive: boolean | optional | Delete the directory even if it is not empty. Defaults to false.
input_schema.missing_ok: boolean | optional | If true, do not raise an error if the directory does not exist. Defaults to false.
input_schema.use_trash: boolean | optional | If true, move the directory to a trash folder instead of permanently deleting. Defaults to true.

output_schema: boolean | True if the directory was deleted, False otherwise.
